Name: Ahitub, Son of Phinehas
Summary: Ahitub, son of Phinehas and grandson of Eli, is named as the father of Ahiah, who served as priest wearing the ephod in Saul's camp.
KeyStory: Ahitub links Eli's fallen house to the priest who served Saul after the ark was lost.
LifeLesson: Even a broken priestly line still carried the ephod and the duty of seeking God.
